decisions.reason: It remained on the home page through 2024 and, in a growing firm with organisational slack, this relatively low-resource adjacent offering is more likely to be retained unless clearer signs of failure emerge.
As a flagship product still given its own page in 2024, it appears to be meeting at least strategic aspiration levels well enough for an expanding, R&D-active firm to continue backing it.

Because it is close to the firm’s core business, was highlighted on the home page in both years, and was explicitly presented as a focal innovation, management is likely to judge it as satisfactory and keep it on the market.
